title: Light Through His Love
label: Anthology · Books for Bibles Press
card_text: Books for Bibles Press presents its first anthology, featuring how God’s love shines even in the darkest places. Ten young authors showcase their talents in thought provoking stories, splashing the pages with rays of light.
description:
## Stories include:

- Realizing God wants everyone to be His child, no matter their circumstances
- A young woman discovering what her ministry is
- Rediscovering one’s passion in a very unique way
- A Bible character discovering what it means to follow God
- Traveling to another country and the hardships of learning to become a missionary
- Showing someone God’s love even when it is difficult
- A journey from darkness to peace and forgiveness
- Learning how God’s love guides one’s footsteps through the hills and valleys of life
- Bringing a ray of sunshine to injured soldiers
- A ride on the Titanic

> “And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.”\
> John 1:5

Books for Bibles Press presents its first anthology, featuring how God’s love shines even in the darkest places. Ten young authors showcase their talents in thought provoking stories, splashing the pages with rays of light.

> Books for Bibles is an organization dedicated to selling books to buy Bibles for those who might not have easy access to them. When you buy a book, you give a Bible! We have yearly anthologies on a multitude of topics in which any aspiring author may participate. To find out more, please check out our website at [booksforbibles.wordpress.com](https://booksforbibles.wordpress.com).

title: Words of Love
label: Biblical Fiction Fantasy
card_text: Words of Love is a Biblical Fiction Fantasy story.
description:
Words of Love is a Biblical Fiction Fantasy story.

Barra is a mother in desperate need of help. Her daughter has been plagued by demons for years, and she and her husband have spent all they can to try and help their daughter.

They have lost hope. Barra is living in darkness and despair.

It isn’t until Barra meets a mysterious man named Isoa that she begins to believe, and when she begins to see light.

Barra is the woman who goes to Jesus, who’s daughter was healed.

Content Labels – The daughter is demon possessed, but it’s not described too much.
